shots.narration: Dua penjelasan kini berhadapan: versi mistis berkata ada penunggu yang mengganggu, versi rasional berkata pengendara lelah dan jalan sempit. Keduanya punya bukti, keduanya punya saksi. Mana yang kalian pilih?
shots.visual_prompt: Split-screen composition inside a Jakarta underpass at night, a ghostly red figure on one side and a tired drowsy driver on the other, both facing the camera, a question hanging between them, harsh vehicle headlight glare, wet asphalt reflections, deep blue night, a police officer's flashlight beam sweeping the wet road, an ambulance's red lights pulsing in the distance

shots.narration: Dan jangan lupa, ada pula paranormal yang mengklaim energi makhluk halus di terowongan ini sangat kuat. Klaim itu tidak bisa dibuktikan, tetapi juga tidak bisa dibantah dengan sekadar tertawa.
shots.visual_prompt: A paranormal investigator holding a glowing device inside a dark Jakarta underpass at night, the meter needle spiking, his face tense, a faint mist swirling around him, harsh vehicle headlight glare, wet asphalt reflections, deep blue night, a shattered side mirror and scattered glass on the asphalt, a tow truck's yellow beacon rotating slowly
shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in on a paranormal investigator inside the dark underpass, his device needle spiking, mist swirling.

shots.narration: Syududu. Empat puluh meter sesudah terowongan, selalu di sana, cerita yang sama, kecelakaan yang sama. Kalau ini hanya kebetulan, kebetulan itu sudah terlalu rajin datang ke tempat yang sama!
shots.visual_prompt: Aerial night view of the same forty-metre stretch past a Jakarta underpass, repeated skid marks and dented barriers glowing under headlights, a faint red figure at the far end, harsh vehicle headlight glare, wet asphalt reflections, deep blue night, a lone traffic cone knocked over at the roadside, a child's sandal lying forgotten near the guardrail

shots.narration: Cerita terowongan ini sudah masuk budaya pop. Pada tahun dua ribu tujuh, sebuah film berjudul Terowongan Casablanca dirilis dan membuat nama lorong ini makin terkenal di seluruh negeri.
shots.visual_prompt: A vintage Indonesian horror film poster for a tunnel ghost story, a red figure looming over a dark underpass, a cinema marquee in Jakarta glowing at night, moviegoers queuing below, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a street sweeper beginning his morning round, birds returning to the wires above the tunnel entrance
shots.video_prompt: Slow tilt up a glowing cinema marquee at night, moviegoers queuing below, a horror poster of a red figure.

shots.narration: Empat tahun kemudian, pada tahun dua ribu sebelas, sebuah buku berjudul enam enam enam Misteri Paling Heboh memuat kisah terowongan ini di antara ratusan misteri lainnya di Indonesia dan dunia.
shots.visual_prompt: Close shot of a thick Indonesian mystery book open on a table, a chapter about a haunted Jakarta tunnel, a hand turning the page, a cup of coffee steaming beside it, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a newspaper vendor arranging the morning papers, the first commuters appearing with coffee cups in hand

shots.narration: Film dan buku itu membuat cerita mistis di sini tidak lagi sekadar bisik-bisik warga. Ia menjadi bagian dari imajinasi nasional, diceritakan ulang di televisi, di radio, dan kini di media sosial.
shots.visual_prompt: A Jakarta living room at night, a family watching a television documentary about a haunted tunnel, a smartphone glowing with social media comments, the screen reflecting on their faces, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a cat stretching on a sun-warmed wall, shop shutters rolling up, the city waking with a cautious yawn
shots.video_prompt: Slow pan across a living room at night, a family watching a tunnel documentary, phones glowing with comments.

shots.narration: Coba hitung: kata kuntilanak terdiri dari sepuluh huruf. Satu tambah nol sama dengan satu. Satu jalan, satu kuburan, satu cerita. Sepuluh huruf itu mengunci semuanya menjadi satu kisah yang sama.
shots.visual_prompt: The word kuntilanak written in glowing letters above a Jakarta underpass at dawn, each letter counted one by one, the letters merging into a single beam of light, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a street sweeper beginning his morning round, birds returning to the wires above the tunnel entrance

shots.narration: Kasablanka kini hidup dalam dua wujud: sebagai jalan yang setiap hari dilalui ribuan kendaraan, dan sebagai legenda yang setiap malam diceritakan ulang. Fakta dan mitos berjalan berdampingan di aspal yang sama.
shots.visual_prompt: Dawn view of a Jakarta underpass, morning traffic flowing through while a faint red figure fades into the mist, a street sweeper starting his shift, the first sunlight touching the concrete, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a newspaper vendor arranging the morning papers, the first commuters appearing with coffee cups in hand
shots.video_prompt: Slow crane shot at dawn over the underpass, morning traffic flowing, a red figure fading into mist.

shots.narration: Ma askoli inna kaliyamata inna asqoli. Paranormal berkata energi di sini kuat, warga berkata penunggu di sini nyata, ilmuwan berkata ini soal jalan sempit dan pikiran yang melamun. Tiga suara, satu terowongan!
shots.visual_prompt: Three figures standing at the mouth of a Jakarta underpass at dawn, a paranormal investigator, a local resident and a scientist in a suit, each gesturing toward the tunnel, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a cat stretching on a sun-warmed wall, shop shutters rolling up, the city waking with a cautious yawn

shots.narration: Kata hujan yang turun di atap terowongan malam itu, ia sudah hafal cerita ini. Hujan turun, membasahi aspal, lalu pergi begitu saja — seperti jawaban yang mampir sebentar lalu pulang tanpa pamit.
shots.visual_prompt: Rain falling on the roof of a Jakarta underpass at dawn, droplets running down the concrete, wet asphalt reflecting the first golden light, an empty road, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a street sweeper beginning his morning round, birds returning to the wires above the tunnel entrance
shots.video_prompt: Slow tracking shot of rain running down the underpass roof at dawn, wet asphalt reflecting golden light.

shots.narration: Jangan pergi dulu: kata jin yang tinggal di balik pagar pemakaman, ia tidak pernah mengganggu siapa pun yang memberi salam. Yang ia ganggu hanya mereka yang melintas sambil sombong dan tidak peduli.
shots.visual_prompt: A shadowy jin figure standing behind a cemetery fence at dawn in Jakarta, watching cars pass through the underpass, one driver honking politely and the figure nodding, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a newspaper vendor arranging the morning papers, the first commuters appearing with coffee cups in hand

shots.narration: Jadi, klakson tiga kali itu sopan santun atau rasa takut? Permisi kepada penunggu, atau sekadar kebiasaan yang diwariskan tanpa pernah dipertanyakan? Jawabannya ada pada diri kalian masing-masing.
shots.visual_prompt: A car driver at dawn in a Jakarta underpass, hand hovering over the horn, thinking, the tunnel exit glowing ahead, a faint red figure in the mirror, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a cat stretching on a sun-warmed wall, shop shutters rolling up, the city waking with a cautious yawn
shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in on a driver at dawn, hand hovering over the horn, tunnel exit glowing ahead.

shots.narration: Hebat, kan? Satu terowongan, satu kuburan, satu kuntilanak merah, tiga klakson, dan empat puluh meter yang selalu menelan korban. Semua itu muat dalam satu koma enam kilometer aspal!
shots.visual_prompt: Wide dawn view of the whole Jakarta underpass and cemetery, a single road cutting through, a red figure, three horn sound waves and a forty-metre marker all visible in one frame, golden dawn light breaking through, warm and cold tones mixing, hopeful yet uncanny, a street sweeper beginning his morning round, birds returning to the wires above the tunnel entrance

shots.narration: Malam ini, kalau kalian melintas di sana, bunyikan klakson tiga kali. Bukan karena kalian percaya, tetapi karena tidak ada ruginya memberi salam kepada sesuatu yang mungkin sedang menunggu di kegelapan.

shots.narration: Jadi, terowongan ini angker karena penunggunya, atau angker karena kita yang terlalu takut untuk mengakuinya? Tulis pendapat kalian di kolom komentar, dan sampai jumpa di film berikutnya!
